Fragmentation is not an inconvenience. It is a cost.
צוות פיתוח עסקי לא מפספס מכרזים כי הוא ל: A business development team does not miss tenders because it is unprofessional. It misses them because nobody can check dozens of portals by hand, every day, before the deadline closes.
עמודי תוצאות ברשימת המכרזים של משרד הביט: pages of results in the Israeli MoD tender list — with no indication of how many there are, and no alert when new ones appear.
משרדים ויחידות שמפרסמים באוסף הפרסומים ה: ministries and units publishing in the government publications collection, each on its own schedule.
נושאי פרסום שונים. מכרז רלוונטי יכול להו: distinct publication subjects. A relevant tender can appear under any one of them.
מועד הגשה שפוספס מספיק כדי למחוק את כל ה: missed deadline is enough to erase every hour invested in the opportunity.
כל שלב מוסר לבא אחריו נתון מאומת. שלב שנ: Each stage hands the next one a verified value. A stage that fails stops and flags — it does not invent a value to keep the chain moving.
סוכן ייעודי לכל פורטל, שמפריד ניווט מחיל: A dedicated agent per portal, separating navigation from extraction — so a redesign breaks only one half. The agent stays locked until its structure has been verified against the live site.
מודל שפה קורא את המסמך ומחלץ תנאי סף, קר: A language model reads the document and extracts eligibility conditions, scoring criteria, specification and award basis — along the PEGS framework. The output is enforced against a schema before it touches the data.
חיפוש היברידי: התאמה סמנטית תופסת מינוח: Hybrid search: semantic matching catches synonymous terminology, and exact keyword matching catches standards and part numbers that semantic similarity blurs.
מכרז שעובר את סף ההתאמה של הפרופיל מייצר: A tender that clears the profile's match threshold generates an alert in the same operation that stores it — there is no window in which a tender exists and nobody knows about it.

לכל מכרז יש קישור לפרסום המקורי, גלוי תמ: Every tender carries a link to the original notice, always visible. A tender that cannot be verified against its source is not stored — better to omit a record than to show an invented address.
המודל מונחה להחזיר ערך ריק כשהמסמך לא או: The model is instructed to return an empty value when the document does not say. Output that fails validation is sent back for correction once, then goes to a human. Unvalidated output is never stored.

מה שנשאלנו, ומה שכדאי לשאול: What we get asked, and what is worth asking
מאיפה מגיעים המכרזים?: Where do the tenders come from?
מפורטלים ציבוריים, דרך סוכן ייעודי לכל מ: From public portals, through a dedicated agent per source. Every source is checked before it is connected: if the site's rules forbid automated collection, we do not connect it, and we seek a proper access arrangement with the operator instead. The Israeli MoD tender-list agent is connected today.
איך אתם מבטיחים שהנתונים נכונים?: How do you guarantee the data is correct?
We do not guarantee it — we make it checkable. Every field is shown beside a link to the original notice, and every extraction is enforced against a schema before it is stored. Anything that fails validation is flagged for human review rather than stored as fact. The decision whether to bid stays with you.
האם המתחרים שלנו יראו מה חיפשנו?: Will our competitors see what we searched for?
לא. פרופילי החיפוש, סטטוסי ההצעה וההערות: No. Search profiles, bid statuses and notes are isolated at the database level, not at the application code level — so even a bug in the application exposes nothing between organisations. That is a design premise, not an addition.
מה קורה עם מכרזים שהמסמכים שלהם סגורים?: What about tenders whose documents are closed?
חלק מהפורטלים מפרסמים רק כותרת, מועד ומס: Some portals publish only a title, a deadline and a reference number — the specification itself sits behind supplier registration. In those cases we show exactly what is public, and mark the extraction as partial. We will not present a thin record as if it were complete.
מתי יהיה כיסוי בינלאומי?: When will there be international coverage?
אחרי שהעומק בשוק הישראלי יהיה מלא. מאגרי: After depth in the Israeli market is complete. Many international databases publish open, official data, so connecting to them is technically simpler — but the value to an Israeli user starts with the local sources. Leave your details and we will update you.
